page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes on the right, beside the lines Davidi defuncto ... Fri-dericus. No left margin text.; One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Below the text: the signature "E 3" at left and the catchword at right.

main_text.p: suæ,& in sexennium à finitâ vitâ proximum, conditionemq; addidit, ut à civitate pen-deretur hoc nomine canon annuus aureorum similium centum; nec verò fas esset prius à civitate repetere successores suos Præfectu-ram dictam, quàm mutuum omne restituis-sent. Davidi defuncto anno M. CCCC XCVI, successit apud Vltrajectinos Fri-Frider. Badensis epifc. Vl-trajec.dericus Badensis: qui cùm nondum quin-quennium rebus præfuisset, armis Saxo-nicis petita civitas est, belloque diuturno æque ac gravi vexata: in quâ cùm auxi-lium Episcopi, patroni ac principis sui, sæpè rogasset, nec solùm non juvaretur ab eo ita uti par erat ex contractus condi-tione, sed haud obscurè premeretur etiam, tandem necessitate ultimâ circumventa, & coacta, sequens id, quod erat in pacti {*}formulâ difertis verbis nuncupatum, in In formulâ hæc erant, Libertate pristinâ, retinere-cum omni jure suo: episcopo fidem principis alius, Edsardi scilicet Frisiæ, quæ ad Orientem Amasi est, Comitis, concessit. Atque hic Ultrajectini juris in civitatem finis fuit. Ab Edsardo deinde ad Carolum Geldrum, à Geldro ad Burgundos imperium hoc devolutum est. Quod quomodò fa-

page.notes: The first word of the page is a continuation from the previous line of print and is transcribed as suæ. The ampersand is printed as a swash form and is given as &. The marginal note is in small italic type and is set over four short lines. The first word "nicis" is a fragment from the cut-off upper part of the page. The asterisk note text is printed in small type, in the right margin, with several hyphenated line breaks. The marginal word "retcum" and its neighbour "retinere-" are hard to read; the reading "retinere cum" is uncertain. "sequens" is read from a faint letter sequence.
